game.name: Battle Kid: Fortress of Peril
game.desc: Battle Kid: Fortress of Peril is a notoriously difficult action platformer for the NES inspired by the "I Wanna Be The Guy" genre. You play as Timmy, infiltrating a fortress filled with pixel-perfect traps and relentless enemies. Created by Sivak Games and released in 2010, it was one of the first commercially sold NES homebrew titles and a true test of patience and reflexes.
